name: MHDV: Inter-axle/Drive-shaft Lubricant Production - Process
notes:
The waste disposal is integrated into the fluid production by introducing the technology named "Emissions from Disposal of Petroleum Napththa as Vehicle Waste" and using Ratio of Waste (=66.7%) to Product to calculate the mass for Crude Naphtha.

The inventory here is assumed to be the same as engine oil for light-duty vehicles (LDVs) (due to lack of any other inventory data). This lubricant is used for both inter-axle shaft and drive shaft in medium-duty and heavy-duty trucks.

Each process should take 1 ton Vehicle in, and 1 ton Vehicle out. The 1 ton is a dummy unit and is not meant to be the actual weight of the vehicle.

Data from "Life Cycle Environmental Assessment of Paint Processes"  Papasavva et al. 2002
